source.title: Investing in the public benefit
source.summary: Anthropic proposes a Public Benefit Fund backed by five percent of its shares, subject to stockholder approval. Potential support for nonprofits or people affected by AI is still to be detailed.

editorial.script: Anthropic has announced a new Public Benefit Fund. The plan would commit five percent of its shares, subject to stockholder approval. Anthropic says the fund could support nonprofits or people affected by AI’s impact on work. Extra shares could be added as the company grows, at the board’s discretion. Details of the fund’s structure and governance are due in the coming months. Our question: how will that commitment translate into help for people? Follow The Prompt for AI news.
